title: Witch with Medusa Head
description: A pale woman in a red pointed hat and cream gown sits on a button-covered throne inside a decaying room. She holds a lit candle while touching the severed head of Medusa, whose purple-scaled snake body coils across the floor near an arched window overlooking a snowy arctic landscape.
prompt: A surreal scene of a witch with white face paint and a tall red pointed hat sitting on an ornate throne completely covered in colorful buttons and eyes. She wears an off-shoulder cream gown and holds a lit candle while reaching out to touch the severed head of Medusa, whose head has writhing snake hair and whose long purple snake body coils across the floor. The room has peeling purple wallpaper and an arched blue window showing a snowy arctic landscape with icebergs at twilight. Dramatic candlelight, scattered buttons and red liquid on the floor, mystical atmosphere.
